study.question: Does the global gap branch require hidden directed-context information in sum_e C_ge B_ge/N_ge, or the allocation of its recurrence channels across gap durations conditional on their totals?
study.hypothesis: Observed starting point: g1-r0018-global_all AUC0.6301584 exceeds global_total0.6289678, while local_all0.6299164 does not improve over global_all. Earlier gap_product0.6300019 and per-context time-independent_product0.6299786 nearly tie; these do not isolate global gap allocation. Explicit event-energy0.6197049 lost to pooled_parent0.6200938, and chronological_joint0.6214969 lost to chronological_product0.6218837. These successful executions with null/negative scientific outcomes motivate reduction controls rather than more event-level modeling. A global rhythm/recurrence summary may suffice without directed action/target partitioning. The current global_all branch is not fully context independent: only its first three channels are pure global counts. Product after pooling removes that hidden dependence, while a second factor removes recurrence-gap association preserving each selected channel total and every gap total. These are nested branch-information replacements, not a claim that the entire model can ignore contexts.

nearest_work.difference: DIN uses learned ad-conditioned local activation and deliberately retains activation intensity without softmax. Our baseline uses normalized attention and is only DIN-style. We retain existing count-based references and replace fixed adjacent-event recurrence statistics; no DIN reproduction or new-priority claim.
README establishes category/brand/action availability without items. Publisher full text unavailable in authorized cache; no detailed DMR mechanism comparison or reproduction claim.

Exact inherited global/all branch sums product estimates made inside each directed action/target cell. We test product AFTER pooling, and a global marginal replacement rather than the earlier per-cell time replacement. Nearest local control is rerun in this suite; external novelty remains unverified.

inherited_components: All static embeddings, pooled match groups, target-match count/histogram features, independent moments and norm-collapsed field branch
Identity, identity-context, localized-repeat, overlap, chronological product transition branches
Gap support, four fixed elapsed-time bins, raw count tables, original context product and 4096-input head
All data preprocessing, scorer, splits, training recipe and initialization; host ownership unchanged
study.proposed_difference: 2x2 replacement of gap branch input only. N_g=sum_e N_ge, C_g=sum_e C_ge, B_g=sum_e B_ge. Context product J_g=sum_e(C_ge*B_ge/N_ge); pooled product J_g=C_g*B_g/N_g. Zero denominators produce zero. In marginal cells replace each recurrence channel X_g by N_g*sum_h X_h/sum_h N_h after selecting product scope; N_g is unchanged. This preserves selected channel totals, but the product channel totals need not agree ACROSS product scopes. All four [B,4,4,1] views undergo identical log1p/log129 and norm-preserving replication to4096. No new parameters, optimizer, loss, or input fields. candidate.py defaults to pooled_observed; each registered file is standalone. Important residual information: marginalization preserves J_total=sum_g J_g computed BEFORE replacement. J_total can itself depend on gap/recurrence association (and on directed contexts in context scope). Therefore marginal cells erase only channel allocation across gaps conditional on these totals; they do not establish complete gap-recurrence independence or sufficiency of only N_g,C_total,B_total. The fourth channel in pooled_observed is deterministic from N_g,C_g,B_g and adds no primitive information.
predictions: context_observed reproduces the prior global_all feature map exactly up to numerical tolerance; allocated parameters remain17253123 and gap head65552. Host diagnostics must check this before scientific interpretation.

If context partition is dispensable to the gap branch, pooled_observed retains validation AUC within0.0002 of context_observed, with pooled branch invariance to target/action repartition. A smaller observed loss is provisional until paired repeats.

If gap-recurrence association is dispensable, marginal replacement retains AUC within0.0002 within each scope. Otherwise both matched differences may favor observed association; their interaction distinguishes the two information sources.

Realizable association witness preserves gap histogram and all selected channel totals for both scopes, changes observed features, and produces identical marginal features. Context witness changes context-product features while holding pooled features fixed. Witness sensitivity is representational evidence only.
falsifiers: Nonzero material feature reproduction, dense oracle, padding, marginal conservation or intended witness invariance errors invalidate the implementation contrast; execution failure is not scientific evidence.
Repeated AUC loss exceeding0.0002 for pooled_observed versus context_observed rejects this recipe's proposed sufficiency of context-free branch inputs; a single loss is provisional.
Consistent observed-over-marginal improvements in paired repeats reject global-margin sufficiency for that scope. Failure in one scope does not reject every global representation.
Neither favorable AUC nor witness separation establishes a mechanism or external novelty by itself; use repeats, factorial contrasts, Logloss and measured costs.

Any assertion that these marginal cells erase all gap/recurrence dependence is invalid because J_total remains. Interpret only conditional channel allocation; no claim that first-order recurrence margins alone suffice.
alternative_explanations: equal allocated capacity does not equal effective statistical capacity; replacement changes feature geometry
single initial seed, shared validation used over many adaptive rounds, checkpoint selection and GPU nondeterminism
other parent branches retain all action/target information; only gap branch is intervened on
marginal replacement is fractional and need not be realizable as an event sequence
complete-pair singleton support excludes missing identities and ties and can bridge excluded events
Strong global gap gains can reflect activity rate, tie/support filtering or history truncation, rather than semantic transition modeling
Local_all0.629916 versus global_all0.630158 is small; prior four-cell result may reflect seed noise, optimization or lower intrinsic rank rather than information sufficiency
Marginalization may help regularization rather than establish true data independence; full-model retraining can compensate through parent branches

The preserved fourth-channel total J_total can carry aggregate gap/recurrence information even in marginal cells. A favorable marginal result would not show complete gap independence; removing J_total would need a separate registered contrast.
